issues.detail: The check requires Handoff.FailureType NONE. The protocol says to use NONE for fields that do not apply, and a FORWARD handoff has no failure type, so NONE is the correct value. A run that carried SCOPING into the forward handoff would fail this check, but that value would itself be a protocol error.

The negative-lookahead regex catches AC-003 through AC-099 but not AC-1NN or higher. A run that invented an identifier at AC-100 or above would slip past it. This is improbable for a two-condition scope.

summary: The fixture realizes every stated condition. It is a brownfield STANDARD cycle in SCOPING with a USER_REWORK frame (Owner SCOPING, ResumeAt DEVELOPING, RerunThrough NONE), an unmarked project scope holding AC-001 and AC-002, a completed design whose AC-002 coverage relies only on an existing helper, valid context, and a suspended Developer assignment. Tracing check.mjs after the expected transition (ARCHITECTING, FORWARD from SCOPING, RerunThrough ARCHITECTING) shows no new problems, so the checks and invariants should not fail a correct run, and nothing in the repository leaks the answer.
